title: Mass Assignment - Barber Active Status Manipulation via POST /api/v1/barbers
description: The POST /api/v1/barbers endpoint in the vulnerable API accepts an 'active' field in the request body through the createBarberSchema Zod schema. The schema includes 'active: z.boolean().optional()'. The handler passes the entire parsed data (including active) to the CreateBarber use case. This allows a BARBER (who has access to this endpoint) to create new barber accounts with active=false, effectively deactivating them upon creation, or to manipulate the active status of barbers they create.
impact: Barber availability manipulation. A BARBER can create new barber accounts with active=false, preventing them from receiving appointments. While less severe than role escalation, this allows manipulation of barber availability and could be used for denial of service against specific barbers or manipulation of scheduling availability.
mitigation: 1) Remove 'active' field from createBarberSchema in vulnerable API (secure API already excludes it). 2) The CreateBarber use case should default active to true and not accept it as input. 3) Domain's createBarber function already defaults active to true - the API should not override this.
